text:
Priya (PM): Heads-up — we need to recruit ~8 design partners for the Priv Preview (VPC / on-prem) targeting Q2 pilots. Looking for input on selection criteria, outreach cadence, incentives, and concrete success metrics. I sketched a draft below.

Kevin (Solutions): +1. I have a shortlist of infra-heavy customers who asked about VPC last quarter. Will share spreadsheet. Criteria: must have internal compliance owners and at least one production LLM workload.

Mike (SRE): We should require a 2-week maintenance window for initial onboarding and a staging environment. Also need their network whitelists 5 days before onboarding.

Ana (Research): Recommend 4-week engagement per partner: week 0 onboarding + test prompts, week 1 product shadowing, week 2 evaluation tasks, week 3 wrap + metrics review. Track quality regressions and latency impact with our eval harness.

Sara (Growth): For incentives: $5k credits for Dedicated/Demo, co-marketing case study, and early-access feature requests prioritized. Keep the language simple in outreach. :thumbsup:

Jared (Eng): We should only promise on-prem rollout if they can accept our minimum infra spec (N GPUs, NVMe, kernel >=5.10). I can make a one-pager.

Priya (PM): Draft success criteria I'm proposing: 1) Partner runs 3 real workflows end-to-end, 2) <=10% quality regression vs hosted baseline, 3) Observability hooks validated (traces, token-level cost), 4) Clear go/no-go decision by end of engagement. Thoughts?

Kevin (Solutions): Those are good. Add 'can sign NDAs + security questionnaire completed' as gating.

Ana (Research): Suggest adding an adoption signal: >20% of pilot users prefer the Redwood solution over their incumbent for a key workflow.

Sara (Growth): Outreach cadence suggestion: initial email, 3-day follow-up, 1-week follow-up, then phone intro. Keep ask = 30–60 min intro call + 4-week pilot. Template below: 

```
Subject: Invite: private preview for Redwood Inference (VPC/on-prem)
Hi [Name],
We’re launching a small private preview of Redwood’s private deployment (VPC / on-prem) and would love to partner with [Company]. We’re looking for teams with production LLM use cases and compliance needs.
We’ll provide: $5k credits, prioritized engineering support, and a joint case study. The pilot is ~4 weeks and includes onboarding, three end-to-end runs, and a metrics review.
Can we book a 30min intro next week?
Thanks,
Priya (PM)
```

Mike (SRE): Add a short checklist in the intro email: basic infra reqs + expected network windows. Saves time.

Priya (PM): Good call — Kevin, can you own the shortlist + first outreach? Sara, can you own the incentive copy + tracking? Ana, you'll own study plan & eval criteria. Mike/Jared — infra readiness checklist + one-pager.

Kevin (Solutions): I’ll take the shortlist and send the first batch early next week.

Sara (Growth): I’ll make a tiny tracker in Sheets with outreach status and incentive acceptance column.

Ana (Research): I’ll spin up the eval harness for the first two partners so we can iterate quickly.

Jared (Eng): One-pager ready by Friday. Will include minimum spec and fallback options for smaller infra.

Priya (PM): Plan for interviews with each partner at weeks 1 & 3. Deliverable: partner runbook, incident checklist, and go/no-go rubric. Will set decision gate: pass >= 3/4 success criteria.

product-bot: Calendar created: "Priv Preview DP Intro" — invites will be sent when outreach accepted.

Kevin (Solutions): tagging @Sara & @Jared so we coordinate the copy and spec. :eyes:

Sara (Growth): noted. I'll draft the first email by Mon EOD and post in #product for review.

Priya (PM): Great — thanks all. If anyone has hard blocks (timing or support) ping me asap.

Mike (SRE): Quick note: add retention of logs for 90 days to the checklist for compliance partners.

Ana (Research): Also recommend capturing three canonical prompts per partner to monitor quality over the pilot.

Priya (PM): Adding both to the plan. I'll update the doc and share link shortly: https://go.redwood/example/priv-preview-plan

Kevin (Solutions): :thumbsup: moving to action.
